'''Mon Calamari Squiduariums''' were a type of [[Aquarium/Legends|fish tank]] produced by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Squiduariums had a certain degree of popularity during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mon Calamari Squiduariums appeared in the massively multiplayer online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] as part of the "Mon Calamari Furniture Set."
